items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: when I first started playing, consists of me, P. Ron, Lil' Allegrette Alexander, Eddie Pearson on trombone... That's the band on the book.

ctx.x: How did Sales rate in those days? He was a nice, fine guitar player. I just wondered who would be among the best guitar players in town. Oh yeah, he was fine, yes indeed.

He always was a musician, you see. He learned the right way. Oh yeah, a musician. That's what I did. He was great, good. Always have been. What about P-Rom's band? P-Rom's band? I played with P-Rom's band from 32 to 35. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with with Song that was after that. He broke up the band. Now his band consists of P. Ron's band, when I first started playing, consists of me, P. Ron, Lil' Allegrette Alexander, Eddie Pearson on trombone,…
